description: Plan amendment 9 (heartbeat): the fixed-width record a securelock overwrites every second, encrypted with AES-256-GCM under the per-order key it announced in securelock.ready, nonce derived from the sequence number, AAD binding the beat to the order; two beats (idle, busy), the object names of both stacks and the securelock.ready plaintext.

order.challengeRule: the enclave challenge the trustedzone forwarded in task.securelock, the same value the securelock binds its result signatures with

runs.encoding: decimal, zero-padded on the left: payload runs started since boot

phase.encoding: B before the payload, T task payload, S session, E idle tail before exit

rules: seq starts at seq0 of securelock.ready and increases by one per beat, never reused under one key
busy turns 1 at the start of a payload run (task start or session input delivery) and 0 at its output; a payload that blocks the event loop leaves the last beat at 1
runs increments when busy turns 1; two idle beats with different runs values mean a payload ran between them
the object is overwritten in place once per second, so its size never changes

key.rule: 32 random bytes drawn by the securelock at boot, hex in securelock.ready; per order, never reused

nonce.rule: seq as a big-endian unsigned integer in the low-order 8 bytes, the 4 leading bytes zero

aad.rule: <challenge>:<order_id>:securelock.heartbeat, UTF-8; the same AAD in both stacks (no .securelock suffix in the AAD)

body.layout: nonce (12) || ciphertext (32) || tag (16) = 60 bytes, stored base64 (80 characters)
body.readerRule: take the nonce from the first 12 bytes, decrypt with the key and AAD, then require the plaintext seq to equal the nonce value

objects.rule: the JS securelock appends .securelock to every object it writes, the Python one writes the bare name; the trustedzone of each stack reads its own stack's names

ready.rule: compact JSON, keys in the order order_id, key, seq0, no whitespace (Python: separators=(",", ":")); encrypted for the trustedzone and signed with the securelock key over "<challenge>:<order_id>:securelock.ready:" + plaintext, as session.ready is
